name: qc_metrics
description: The qc_* family's metric stage: one map_record operator per metric family, each mapping a fixed set of input columns onto the metric's output channel. Reproduces the shape stage 2.2 of qc_biometric.pc.json has three times over, which is the case that failed round 1 of the phase 0 plan's 5.3.9 experiment.

holes.name: metric_operators
holes.prompt: One map_record operator per metric in `metrics`. Each writes to that metric's own output channel and leaves the input record otherwise untouched. This is the OUTER level: it repeats over metrics, not over columns.

holes.name: metric_columns
holes.prompt: One column transformation per entry of `input_columns`, inside a single metric operator. This is the INNER level: it repeats over columns within one metric. A text marker cannot distinguish this hole from `metric_operators` - both are 'the metric marker' - which is why each declares its own repeat_over.

holes.name: partition_output
holes.prompt: The single partition_writer that closes the stage. Fills once: it does not repeat over anything.
